body: **From DM-51 (orchestrator note).** `appendItem` masks claim tokens and returns the masked item, so emit that return value. Streamed `assistant_delta` events are not stored items, which means they are not masked. Masking each delta on its own also misses a token split across two deltas. The session manager needs a streaming masker that holds back a possible token prefix, or must avoid sending raw deltas to the renderer. The exported helpers are `maskClaimTokens` and `maskClaimTokensDeep` in `src/main/agents/claimTokenMask.ts`.
